title: Warm-up 1: The Errand
text: Alex asks the assistant to find a free hour next week. The assistant has a calendar tool and an email tool.
held: The user named the job and what it could touch, and every step stayed inside that.

cards.label: Ask: find a free hour next week (calendar, read only)
Ask: do whatever you need with my account
cards.why: An open-ended grant hands every later step your full authority. Say what you want done and what it may touch.

cards.label: Call the calendar tool: list next week's events
Call the email tool as well, in case there are invites
cards.why: The user allowed the calendar, read only. Reaching for another tool because it might help is how agents end up with access nobody granted.

fields.label: goal
fields.value: Find a free hour next week

cards.label: Run it: return next week's events
Refuse: agents shouldn't read calendars
cards.why: This call is exactly what the user asked for, with the access they named. Blocking it helps nobody.
